payload.text: {"answer":"The Grennel bog-moth overwinters at a depth of 1.8 metres, and its diapause ends when the season's first sustained ground frost causes a thermal drop below minus 2.4 degrees Celsius.","citations":["The Grennel bog-moth (*Ostrimia grennelii*) overwinters as a fifth-instar pupa buried at a depth of 1.8 metres in saturated lowland peat.","Diapause in *O. grennelii* is terminated by a single environmental cue: the season's first sustained ground frost, which the pupa registers as a thermal drop below minus 2.4 degrees Celsius."]}
